notes.title: Free unofficial open world Superman game Undefeated gets a PC update with heat vision alongside a surprise PS5 launch
notes.notes: Sometimes we play video games to plunder the silty depths of our emotions, sometimes we play them to sharpen our wits and try the alchemy of engrossing systems, sometimes we play them to mud-wrestle with questions of power and responsibility, and sometimes we just want to wear cool sunglasses, have big arms, and fly around hitting stuff very hard.  Read more

notes.title: New super power is now available - Super Power Update!
notes.notes:
Hi! This is the "UNDEFEATED" dev team.
Thank you for your continued support of "UNDEFEATED”. It truly means a lot to all of us.

We have added the long-awaited super power to celebrate the release of the PS5 version and 2 million downloads.

[previewyoutube=VOIrhnkLUaU;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes
New Super Power

Added new super powers unlocked when hero rank is B or higher.
If you have already met the conditions, you can use it.
New Events

Added new events that occur when the hero rank is B or higher.
You can transform the newly added superpower into “the long-awaited superpower”.
Gameplay Changes

Supports 4K resolution (3840x2160) and WQHD resolution (2560x1440)
Some billboards have been redesigned.
The billboards were redesigned during the last major update, and they continue to appear in this update as well. Please try to find them.
[hr][/hr]
This year marks the fifth year since UNDEFEATED's release.
UNDEFEATED has also started to be released on PS5 today, and the PC (Steam) version has finally surpassed 2 million downloads. We had no idea that our student project would have such a big impact.
We would like to send our thanks to everyone once again.

Thank you for your continued support of 'UNDEFEATED'.

This update is our way of saying thank you to all of our users who have always supported us.
Please enjoy the new super powers.

For more information about the PS5 version of UNDEFEATED, which was released today, and the decision to release the PS5 version of UNDEFEATED: Genesis, please read this article.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2088020/view/4580811814120724098

We will continue to work hard on development with the aim of releasing 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis' in 2026.
Please check out the store page and add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/

[hr][/hr]
Our goal continues to be to make the most exciting hero experience possible and that will continue in UNDEFEATED: Genesis!

From all of us on the UNDEFEATED team, thank you all for your continued support of 'UNDEFEATED'.

notes.title: Major Update Available!
notes.notes:
Hi! This is the "UNDEFEATED" dev team.
Thank you for your continued support of "UNDEFEATED”. It truly means a lot to all of us.

We are excited to let everyone know that we have fixed the major issue which led to the game crashing for many players.
We have also made other small fixes and changes so please check them out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35464748/461d5a7008fe047ffd8918256a77de71d9e07b6b.png

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes
Crash Bugs

Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash on startup.
Fixed an issue where the game would crash after a certain amount of time from the start of the game.
We have done our best to fix these issues. However, these fixes may still not make the game playable for everyone, but we believe it is now playable for more people than ever before. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
Language support

The language setting is now set to "English" when the game is launched for the first time.
The display may sometimes still show a mixture of Japanese and English. If you encounter this issue, please try changing language and back again.
Gameplay Changes

Fixed a bug where the normal number of gangs was not generated and quests did not progress.
Increased the amount of damage dealt to bosses based on the player’s hero rank.
Fixed a problem where citizens would remain in a "running away" state.
Some billboards have been redesigned.

Easter Eggs

We have added a very small number of Easter Eggs…

[hr][/hr]
Finally, thank you for supporting UNDEFEATED for the past four years.
We are now working hard to release UNDEFEATED: Genesis in 2026.

Please check out our store page and add it to your wishlist. It helps us a huge amount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/

[hr][/hr]
Our goal continues to be to make the most exciting hero experience possible and that will continue in UNDEFEATED: Genesis!

From all of us on the UNDEFEATED team, thank you all for your continued support of "UNDEFEATED".

notes.title: [UPDATE] Game crashing issues
notes.notes:
Hi! This is Yuma and Daigo from the "UNDEFEATED" dev team.
Thank you for your continued support of "UNDEFEATED”.

We first released this game four years ago in August 2019. Since then, there have been over 1.95m downloads! We never expected so many people to play our free student project and we’re extremely grateful to everyone that has.

THANK YOU SO MUCH!

This post is to let everyone know that we have seen the reviews about the game crashing and we are currently working on a fix. We expect to finish development on the patch by the end of February.

Once released, we cannot guarantee that the fix will work for everyone and would appreciate your understanding in this regard.
As soon as we are ready to release the patch, we will post an update here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35464748/d4c4763292bd086fa4801c308676c4930bec8e26.png
[hr][/hr]
Our small team is currently focused on the development of the sequel to this game, UNDEFEATED: Genesis.
Once we have finished and launched the patch for "UNDEFEATED", we will get back to making "UNDEFEATED: Genesis" the best game we can.

Please check out the store page and add to your wish list - it helps us a lot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/
